title: Services
intro: Everything we make is made to order. Start with a consultation; we quote once we know the design and the cloth.

process.title: Consultation
process.body: An hour with a designer: what you need, how you live in your clothes.

process.title: Design
process.body: Sketches and cloth: shweshwe, umbhaco, silk or wool, with beadwork if you want it.

process.title: Pattern & fittings
process.body: A paper pattern from your measurements, then two or three fittings in calico and cloth.

process.title: Finishing
process.body: Sewn and beaded by hand in South Africa, then delivered or shipped worldwide.

appointments.title: In the studio
appointments.body: An hour with a designer, cloth books on the table.

appointments.title: By video
appointments.body: For clients abroad. We send a measuring guide and fit on your visits to Pretoria.

appointments.title: For a ceremony
appointments.body: Weddings, umembeso and lobola: outfits for the whole family, coordinated.

offerings.title: Traditional
offerings.body: Umbhaco, shweshwe and beadwork for weddings, umembeso and lobola, with bead colours chosen for your family.

offerings.title: Eveningwear
offerings.body: Gowns and kaftans in silk and shweshwe, with detachable beaded collars and hand-finished hems.

offerings.title: Daywear
offerings.body: Dresses and sets in indigo shweshwe and hand-dyed adire, cut to wear every day.

offerings.title: Menswear
offerings.body: Suits, agbada, kaftans and shirts, with beaded lapels or kente details where you want them.

aftercare.title: Alterations
aftercare.body: Alterations are free for the first year, anywhere we ship.
